WITH closed AS (
    UPDATE public.sync_runs
    SET
        status = 'failed',
        finished_at = now(),
        heartbeat_at = now(),
        error_code = 'stale_run',
        error_message = 'Run closed automatically after heartbeat timeout'
    WHERE
        owner_login = ($1::jsonb ->> 'owner_login')
        AND status = 'running'
        AND heartbeat_at <
            now() -
            (
                ($1::jsonb ->> 'stale_after_minutes')::integer
                * interval '1 minute'
            )
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS stale_runs_closed
FROM closed;

WITH attempted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.sync_runs (
        owner_login,
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        ($1::jsonb ->> 'owner_login'),
        'running'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (owner_login)
        WHERE status = 'running'
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    attempted.id,
    (attempted.id IS NOT NULL) AS created
FROM (SELECT 1) AS single_row
LEFT JOIN attempted ON true;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
)

UPDATE public.sync_runs
SET
    status = 'failed',
    finished_at = now(),
    heartbeat_at = now(),

    error_code =
        input.j ->> 'error_code',

    error_message =
        input.j ->> 'safe_message',

    last_github_request_id =
        NULLIF(
            input.j ->> 'github_request_id',
            ''
        )

FROM input

WHERE
    sync_runs.id =
        (input.j ->> 'run_id')::bigint

RETURNING
    sync_runs.id AS run_id,
    sync_runs.status,
    sync_runs.error_code,
    sync_runs.error_message;

INSERT INTO public.sync_runs (
    owner_login,
    status,
    finished_at,
    error_code,
    error_message
)
VALUES (
    ($1::jsonb ->> 'owner_login'),
    'skipped',
    now(),
    'concurrent_run',
    'Another synchronization is already running'
)
RETURNING
    id,
    owner_login,
    status,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    pages_fetched,
    records_received,
    records_inserted,
    records_updated,
    records_deactivated;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),

updated AS (
    UPDATE public.sync_runs
    SET
        status =
            'failed',

        finished_at =
            now(),

        heartbeat_at =
            now(),

        error_code =
            input.j ->> 'error_code',

        error_message =
            input.j ->> 'safe_message',

        rate_limit_limit =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'rate_limit_limit',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                sync_runs.rate_limit_limit
            ),

        rate_limit_remaining =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'rate_limit_remaining',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                sync_runs.rate_limit_remaining
            ),

        rate_limit_reset_at =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'rate_limit_reset_at',
                    ''
                )::TIMESTAMPTZ,
                sync_runs.rate_limit_reset_at
            ),

        last_github_request_id =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'github_request_id',
                    ''
                ),
                sync_runs.last_github_request_id
            )

    FROM input

    WHERE
        sync_runs.id =
            (input.j ->> 'run_id')::BIGINT

    RETURNING sync_runs.id
)

SELECT
    input.j AS context

FROM input
JOIN updated ON true;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),

upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.github_profiles (
        github_user_id,
        login,
        name,
        bio,
        company,
        location,
        blog,
        html_url,
        avatar_url,
        public_repos,
        followers,
        following,
        github_created_at,
        github_updated_at,
        synced_at
    )
    SELECT
        (j -> 'profile' ->> 'github_user_id')::BIGINT,
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'login',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'name',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'bio',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'company',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'location',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'blog',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'html_url',
        j -> 'profile' ->> 'avatar_url',
        (j -> 'profile' ->> 'public_repos')::INTEGER,
        (j -> 'profile' ->> 'followers')::INTEGER,
        (j -> 'profile' ->> 'following')::INTEGER,
        NULLIF(
            j -> 'profile' ->> 'github_created_at',
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ,
        NULLIF(
            j -> 'profile' ->> 'github_updated_at',
            ''
        )::TIMESTAMPTZ,
        now()
    FROM input

    ON CONFLICT (github_user_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        login =
            EXCLUDED.login,

        name =
            EXCLUDED.name,

        bio =
            EXCLUDED.bio,

        company =
            EXCLUDED.company,

        location =
            EXCLUDED.location,

        blog =
            EXCLUDED.blog,

        html_url =
            EXCLUDED.html_url,

        avatar_url =
            EXCLUDED.avatar_url,

        public_repos =
            EXCLUDED.public_repos,

        followers =
            EXCLUDED.followers,

        following =
            EXCLUDED.following,

        github_created_at =
            EXCLUDED.github_created_at,

        github_updated_at =
            EXCLUDED.github_updated_at,

        synced_at =
            now()

    RETURNING
        github_user_id,
        login
)

SELECT
    input.j ||
    jsonb_build_object(
        'profile_persisted',
        true
    ) AS context

FROM input
CROSS JOIN upserted;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),

incoming AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset(
        (
            SELECT j -> 'repositories'
            FROM input
        )
    )
    AS r (
        github_repo_id TEXT,
        owner_login TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        full_name TEXT,
        description TEXT,
        html_url TEXT,
        language TEXT,
        topics JSONB,
        visibility TEXT,
        default_branch TEXT,
        fork BOOLEAN,
        archived BOOLEAN,
        disabled BOOLEAN,
        stargazers_count INTEGER,
        watchers_count INTEGER,
        forks_count INTEGER,
        open_issues_count INTEGER,
        size INTEGER,
        github_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        github_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        github_pushed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
    )
),

existing AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        gr.github_repo_id
    FROM public.github_repositories gr
    JOIN incoming i
      ON gr.github_repo_id =
         i.github_repo_id::BIGINT
),

upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.github_repositories (
        github_repo_id,
        owner_login,
        name,
        full_name,
        description,
        html_url,
        language,
        topics,
        visibility,
        default_branch,
        fork,
        archived,
        disabled,
        stargazers_count,
        watchers_count,
        forks_count,
        open_issues_count,
        size,
        github_created_at,
        github_updated_at,
        github_pushed_at,
        first_seen_at,
        last_seen_at,
        last_seen_run_id,
        is_active
    )

    SELECT
        i.github_repo_id::BIGINT,
        i.owner_login,
        i.name,
        i.full_name,
        i.description,
        i.html_url,
        i.language,
        i.topics,
        i.visibility,
        i.default_branch,
        i.fork,
        i.archived,
        i.disabled,
        i.stargazers_count,
        i.watchers_count,
        i.forks_count,
        i.open_issues_count,
        i.size,
        i.github_created_at,
        i.github_updated_at,
        i.github_pushed_at,
        now(),
        now(),
        (
            SELECT
                (j ->> 'run_id')::BIGINT
            FROM input
        ),
        true

    FROM incoming i

    ON CONFLICT (github_repo_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        owner_login =
            EXCLUDED.owner_login,

        name =
            EXCLUDED.name,

        full_name =
            EXCLUDED.full_name,

        description =
            EXCLUDED.description,

        html_url =
            EXCLUDED.html_url,

        language =
            EXCLUDED.language,

        topics =
            EXCLUDED.topics,

        visibility =
            EXCLUDED.visibility,

        default_branch =
            EXCLUDED.default_branch,

        fork =
            EXCLUDED.fork,

        archived =
            EXCLUDED.archived,

        disabled =
            EXCLUDED.disabled,

        stargazers_count =
            EXCLUDED.stargazers_count,

        watchers_count =
            EXCLUDED.watchers_count,

        forks_count =
            EXCLUDED.forks_count,

        open_issues_count =
            EXCLUDED.open_issues_count,

        size =
            EXCLUDED.size,

        github_created_at =
            EXCLUDED.github_created_at,

        github_updated_at =
            EXCLUDED.github_updated_at,

        github_pushed_at =
            EXCLUDED.github_pushed_at,

        -- NÃO alterar first_seen_at

        last_seen_at =
            now(),

        last_seen_run_id =
            EXCLUDED.last_seen_run_id,

        is_active =
            true

    RETURNING github_repo_id
),

stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER
            AS records_persisted,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE e.github_repo_id IS NULL
        )::INTEGER
            AS records_inserted,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE e.github_repo_id IS NOT NULL
        )::INTEGER
            AS records_updated

    FROM upserted u

    LEFT JOIN existing e
      ON e.github_repo_id =
         u.github_repo_id
)

SELECT
    (
        input.j - 'repositories'
    )
    ||
    jsonb_build_object(
        'records_inserted',
        stats.records_inserted,

        'records_updated',
        stats.records_updated
    )
    AS context

FROM input
CROSS JOIN stats;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),

updated AS (
    UPDATE public.sync_runs
    SET
        heartbeat_at =
            now(),

        pages_fetched =
            sync_runs.pages_fetched + 1,

        records_received =
            sync_runs.records_received
            +
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'records_received',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                0
            ),

        records_inserted =
            sync_runs.records_inserted
            +
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'records_inserted',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                0
            ),

        records_updated =
            sync_runs.records_updated
            +
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'records_updated',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                0
            ),

        rate_limit_limit =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'rate_limit_limit',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                sync_runs.rate_limit_limit
            ),

        rate_limit_remaining =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'rate_limit_remaining',
                    ''
                )::INTEGER,
                sync_runs.rate_limit_remaining
            ),

        rate_limit_reset_at =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'rate_limit_reset_at',
                    ''
                )::TIMESTAMPTZ,
                sync_runs.rate_limit_reset_at
            ),

        last_github_request_id =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    input.j ->> 'github_request_id',
                    ''
                ),
                sync_runs.last_github_request_id
            )

    FROM input

    WHERE
        sync_runs.id =
            (input.j ->> 'run_id')::BIGINT

    RETURNING
        sync_runs.id
)

SELECT
    input.j AS context
FROM input
JOIN updated ON true;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),

deactivated AS (
    UPDATE public.github_repositories
    SET
        is_active = false

    FROM input

    WHERE
        github_repositories.owner_login =
            input.j ->> 'owner_login'

        AND github_repositories.is_active = true

        AND github_repositories.last_seen_run_id
            IS DISTINCT FROM
            (input.j ->> 'run_id')::BIGINT

    RETURNING
        github_repositories.github_repo_id
),

stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER
            AS records_deactivated
    FROM deactivated
)

SELECT
    input.j
    ||
    jsonb_build_object(
        'records_deactivated',
        stats.records_deactivated
    )
    AS context

FROM input
CROSS JOIN stats;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
)

UPDATE public.sync_runs
SET
    status =
        'succeeded',

    finished_at =
        now(),

    heartbeat_at =
        now(),

    records_deactivated =
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                input.j ->> 'records_deactivated',
                ''
            )::INTEGER,
            0
        )

FROM input

WHERE
    sync_runs.id =
        (input.j ->> 'run_id')::BIGINT

RETURNING
    sync_runs.id
        AS run_id,

    sync_runs.owner_login,

    sync_runs.status,

    sync_runs.started_at,

    sync_runs.finished_at,

    sync_runs.rate_limit_limit,

      safe_message:
        x.safe_transport_message
        ??
        `${x.request_kind} request failed with HTTP ${
          x.http_status ?? 'unknown'
        }`
    }
  }
];
